ItacPersonItem.Notes: Jurist. Joined the Ricovrati in 1599. In 1600 he delivered a Latin oration in the Ricovrati Academy: `De disciplinis quae ad leges percipiendas aditum sternunt`. In 1601 he commented on Petrarch`s sonnet `Era il giorno che al sol si scoloraro`. In 1604 he discussed the importance of the printing press and its benefit. His portrait comes from Tomasini, Illustrium virorum elogia (1630).
